node.statement: For this same packet, lem-routef-threshold-minimum applies. Its eta_K is exactly equation (1.8), eta_K=min{rho_fac,(24*K)^(-1),1}; therefore the root assumption 0 <= eta <= eta_K gives 0 <= eta <= min{(24*K)^(-1),1}, 3*K*eta <= 1/8 < 1, and 3*K*eta/(1-3*K*eta) <= 4*K*eta <= 1/6 < 1/2.
